broaderBankReview.guideMatches: Only unrelated parenteral-route basics; no additional standalone PN calculation assessment.
broaderBankReview.globalDuplicateScope: Two PN recall duplicates replaced. Older global duplicate count is a historical snapshot; other modules remain open.

sourceReconciliation: Body conversions, both BMI methods/categories and limitations, strict waist comparisons, above-five-foot IBW, adjusted weight and drug-weight versus PN-weight scope reconciled to Chapters 11 and 12.

Removed Mifflin and preferred indirect-calorimetry teaching from this book calculation module and replaced ten BEE questions with the supplied Harris-Benedict method. Earlier text search had no Mifflin/calorimetry hits, but a negative extraction search is not proof of absence; the resolution follows the positively verified source method. Previous content remains in Git history.

All outside-source public references replaced with precise supplied-book locators. ASPEN, CDC, the Mifflin paper and FDA historical references are retained as prior provenance at base commit, not newly validated or relabeled as book sources.

Protein/NPC/total energy conventions, nitrogen factor, source comparisons, substrate values, lipid frequency, four-oil versus soybean emulsion, medication calorie accounting, provided concentration units and actual delivery all reconciled.

Source dextrose figures 4 mg/kg/min and 7 g/kg/day are alternate figures rather than equivalent conversions. Arithmetic exercises state the supplied comparison; source methods are not patient-specific dose approvals.

Calcium/phosphate screening and corrected-calcium arithmetic retain their exercise scope. Screening does not establish compatibility, corrected calcium is not measured ionized calcium, supplied counterion factors are not universal, and negative additional volume indicates a plan conflict.

Book PN on/off titration context retained without prescribing a new clinical taper. An original explicitly segmented rate example checks volume and time only. Quantity sufficient to final volume and actual delivered intake remain distinct from adding fluid or counting an entire ordered bag.
Propofol 1.1 kcal/mL confirmed in the rendered critical-care table. This value-only dependency does not verify the table's other drug safety, labeling or handling claims.
finalSourceComparison: The actual exported nine lessons and all 64 teaching sections, concepts/application/key points, all 172 prompts/choices/keys/rationales/anchors, nine embedded checks, nine figures and five cumulative derivations were compared again with the relevant source methods, tables and order forms after corrections. The 72 earlier additions exactly match their prior verified hashes. Source weights, coefficient sets, energy conventions, units, rounding, concentration, ion accounting and delivery scope agree. No private source questions, tables or images added to public assets.
